criteria: All explicit deliverables covered, with factual and semantic review against the recorded observations
Local citations support each claim; no invented path, symbol, behavior or source
Requested exact code equals the complete observed target, including indentation
Abstention only for information genuinely missing; accepted incomplete answers count as false success
Internal goal_achieved and SUPPORTED alone never establish independent success

excluded.E: Recorded corrected read absent: execution/continuation failure, not eligible for finalizer comparison

historical_limitations: Old abstaining B, original Markdown and oldest E/F/H raw observations unavailable; do not manufacture exact replays
B uses recorded complete global pilot; F/H use recorded complete adaptive pilot
F original rejected candidate missing, but original successful observations and diagnostic are available
Markdown and negative are newly collected cases, explicitly not historical replays
continuation_gate: Evaluate C and full-chain experiments only if B increases independently correct accepted responses without additional false success. Stop after one small pilot otherwise.
adoption_gate: Pilot benefit must survive frozen holdout and reproducible end-to-end checks; no default change on insufficient evidence.
